description: Read the matter message thread between the firm and the awarded vendor. Use when the user asks whether the vendor has questions, sent an update, said anything, or needs anything - and ALWAYS check messages when reporting matter status, since an unanswered vendor question blocks the work. Returns the full thread plus the unread count; reading marks the vendor's messages as read for the firm. Requires SCOPE_API_TOKEN.

matter_id.description: Matter display id (SC-2041), UUID, or slug.

name: scope_get_messages
